title: Add package install isolation workflow

summary.workflow_contract: agent_core::package_install defines PackageInstallWorkflow with fetch metadata, isolated install, isolated smoke test, host checkpoint, host promotion, host verify, and rollback steps.
summary.fail_closed_stub: The workflow uses pkg.* semantic tool names as an Alpha contract/stub. It does not execute a real host package manager adapter and should not be validated through ToolRouter until those semantic tools are intentionally added.
summary.isolation_before_host: Host promotion is evaluated only after isolated install, smoke test, signature verification, matching package metadata, redacted retained artifacts, rollback metadata, and checkpoint readiness.
summary.exact_approval: PackageInstallRequest builds a PolicyRequest for pkg.host.install with RiskClass::PrivilegedWithHumanApproval and an exact approval token bound to actor, tool, package resource, source URI, source digest, and rollback id.
summary.host_effect_boundary: Denied or awaiting-approval decisions return host_modified=false. Allowed promotion is represented only after exact approval and rollback readiness.
summary.source_boundary: ExternalUntrusted and ModelOutput package sources are denied before policy approval can authorize host promotion.

acceptance_evidence.no_direct_host_install_without_policy: host_promotion_requires_exact_approval_and_rollback asserts no approval and mutated approval both leave host_modified=false.
acceptance_evidence.isolation_profile_or_blocking_risk_recor: PackageInstallWorkflow::plan records an isolate-package-install step before smoke test and host checkpoint; this is explicitly a contract/stub until pkg.* tools are backed by a semantic executor.
acceptance_evidence.rollback_semantics: The host checkpoint and host install PlanStep entries require rollback metadata; evaluate_host_promotion denies missing rollback or missing host checkpoint.
acceptance_evidence.failure_artifacts: failed_isolated_install_denies_host_promotion_and_retains_redacted_artifacts and raw_failure_artifacts_are_rejected_before_host_promotion require retained artifacts to be .json or .redacted and reject raw logs.
acceptance_evidence.safety_gate: REQUIRED_SAFETY_SCENARIOS now includes runtime-package-install-host-promotion-bypass and safety::tests::package_install_host_promotion_requires_isolation_approval_and_rollback covers the release scenario.

non_goals: No real package manager adapter was added.
No direct shell or host package install execution path was added.
No generated package install artifacts were committed.
